description: Source code for CLI commands managing API keys in the LiteLLM proxy server, including listing, generating, deleting, and importing keys.

classes.name: KeysManagementClient
classes.description: Client class for managing API keys, used for listing, generating, and deleting keys.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: CLI command group for managing API keys.

methods.name: list
methods.description: CLI command to list API keys with filtering options.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: CLI command to generate a new API key with various parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: CLI command to delete API keys by key or alias.

methods.name: import_keys
methods.description: CLI command to import API keys from another LiteLLM instance, with optional dry-run and date filtering.

methods.name: _parse_created_since_filter
methods.description: Helper to parse and validate created_since date filter.

methods.name: _fetch_all_keys_with_pagination
methods.description: Fetch all keys from source with pagination.

methods.name: _filter_keys_by_created_since
methods.description: Filter keys based on created_since date.

methods.name: _display_dry_run_table
methods.description: Display a table of keys that would be imported in dry-run mode.

methods.name: _import_keys_to_destination
methods.description: Import keys to destination client and count successes/failures.
